sources.what: Names, sizes and SHA-256 hashes of the files inside the split ZIP in scripts/data/release-photos.json, plus its five small top-level documents and the photo lists of 249 profiles for review. The application script is read, never run. No image is published or assumed reusable merely because it is in the archive.
